name: Generated file guard
summary: Prevent direct agent edits to files that are conclusively generated artifacts.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate for Write and Edit that recognizes explicit generated-file headers, narrow generated filename conventions, and exact project policy paths without treating broad build directories as generated by default.
refuses: It does not regenerate a protected file, identify its generator, or edit its source template.
It does not classify every file under generic build or dist directories as generated.
It does not expose a project-writable policy, inline suppression, or agent-controlled exception path.

entrypoints.purpose: Collect a bounded file header and deterministically protect confirmed generated outputs.
